paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled "Recall@10" presents an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of different components of a conversation recommendation system. The horizontal axis lists four categories: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", arranged from left to right. The vertical axis represents Recall@10, scaled linearly from 0.1 to 0.4 with tick marks at 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4. The "Ours" method, represented by an orange bar, achieves the highest Recall@10, with a value approximately 0.34. The "- critiquing" method, shown as a dark blue bar, has a Recall@10 of about 0.28. The "- scoring" method, also dark blue, attains a lower value of approximately 0.16. The "- ranking" method, similarly dark blue, achieves a Recall@10 of roughly 0.23. The bars are not sorted by value but follow a logical order corresponding to the ablation of components from the full model ("Ours"). No additional visual emphasis (e.g., shading or annotations) is applied to any bar, and the chart uses a simple grid layout with no legend, relying on the axis labels and bar colors to distinguish the methods.
